identifier_rule: UnitId is globally unique. Abbreviation is display/reference data only and is not globally unique.

ability.text: If it has already moved this turn, after attacking it may make a 2-Diamond movement.
After attacking, every unit adjacent to the target takes 25 damage, including friendly units.
Attacks ignore units and terrain for line of sight.
As an attack, attach to a friendly non-Royal unit. While attached, the Guard takes incoming damage for that unit. A unit may have only one Guard attached.

As an attack, build either two Stone Walls (5 gold each, 50 Health; impassable and block enemy attacks) or two Gatehouses (15 Health; friendly units may pass through, enemies may not). May demolish any structure in range for free.
Earns 10 gold at the start of each owner turn. Units may move and attack over it.
Once per owner turn, choose one friendly unit in range. While selected, it deals +10 damage and takes 10 less damage. A Baron may affect only one unit at a time.
Takes 15 less damage from attacks originating more than 1 Square away, to a minimum of 0.
May attack up to three times per owner turn.
After attacking a unit, push it 2 tiles directly away. If the full push would be illegal, stop it at the furthest legal square before that.
May move through enemy units, dealing 30 damage to each crossed unit. Ignores terrain and rivers.
As an attack, attach to a friendly 1×1 unit. While attached, that unit gains +2 Move; when it takes damage, the Ox takes the same damage. Only one Ox may be attached to a unit.

As an attack, build either two Bridges over rivers or lakes, or one Watchtower for 15 gold with 15 Health. A friendly unit occupying a Watchtower gains +2 Attack Range and the Watchtower takes damage in its place. May demolish any structure in range for free.
As an attack, choose a friendly unit in range that has already moved; it may move once more this turn. A unit may be refreshed by a War Drum only once per owner turn.
Cannot take more than 12 damage from a single attack or effect.
When bought, choose X from 40 to 160 gold in multiples of 20. Its Attack is 10 + X/4 and its Health is 20 + X/2.

Its attack also hits every unit directly adjacent to the target. After attacking, it must reload before attacking again. As an active ability, an adjacent friendly unit may reload it; it cannot attack and reload on the same owner turn.
Once per owner turn, as an attack, destroy one terrain tile in range and gain 15 gold.
The first time it would die, transform it in the same position into a Terracotta Warrior. The Terracotta Warrior remains your Royal.
Unchoosable. This is the Emperor's second form; if it dies, the Royal is defeated.
Earns 10 gold at the start of each owner turn. Friendly units moving closer to the Palace gain +1 Move for that movement and ignore terrain costs.
Ignores forests for movement.
When it attacks, it also attacks every other unit in its attack range, including friendly units.
Cannot move normally. As its movement, swap positions with another 1×1 unit within Move range; both final positions must be legal.
Its attack also damages every other unit in the 3×3 area centred on the target.

As an attack, create a 3×3 Poison Cloud that deals 15 damage to every unit inside at the start of each owner turn. A Witch may have only one cloud active; it disappears if dispelled or the Witch dies.

As an attack, grow a Bramble on an adjacent empty square. A Bramble has 30 Health. Units may move through it but take 10 damage when entering and cannot end movement on it; the Bramble also takes 10 damage each time it is crossed.

As an attack, pick up one directly adjacent 1×1 unit. It moves with the Giant and cannot move itself, but may attack the Giant if in range. The Giant may throw its carried unit to an empty square within 2–3 Circle.
When bought, immediately pay 30 gold upkeep. At the start of each owner turn, pay another 30 gold or the Golem becomes neutral. You may fire it on your turn, making it neutral.
Ignores Fire. When it attacks, it hits every unit within its Forward Line attack range.
May be placed in No-Man's-Land.

Ignores terrain and Fire. Once per owner turn, as an active ability costing 5 Health, create Fire on one tile in range. A unit entering or ending movement on Fire takes 15 damage, then the Fire is destroyed.
Attacks ignore line-of-sight blockers, including units, forests, terrain and barricades.
This Royal consists of four separate 1×1 Goblins. You are defeated only when all four have died.
Ignores structures and terrain for movement and line of sight.
When it dies, spawn a Flesh in its position.
Unchoosable. At the start of its owner's next turn, transform into a Zombie.
Deals its Attack damage to a unit by ending movement on that unit's square.
When placed, place one Skeleton Minion within 4 Squares. If that Minion dies while the Necromancer lives, respawn it adjacent to the Necromancer at the start of your next owner turn.

Unchoosable. Cannot move more than 4 Squares from its Necromancer. If killed while its Necromancer lives, it respawns adjacent to the Necromancer at the start of the next owner turn. It dies permanently when its Necromancer dies.
At the end of its fourth owner turn, it dies.
Heals 15 Health after attacking.
Must be placed on one friendly non-Royal unit. It moves with that unit, cannot be targeted separately, and dies when its host dies. Its attacks ignore terrain and units for line of sight.
May attack friendly units. If it does not attack any unit during its owner turn, it dies at the end of that turn.
As an active ability, it may Settle. Once Settled, it becomes a Structure and cannot move; as an attack, it may then spawn one Wisp on an adjacent empty square.
Unchoosable. Dies immediately after attacking.
Ignores terrain. Once per owner turn, as an active ability, pick up one Structure in range or place its currently held Structure on an empty tile in range. It may hold only one Structure.
If it kills a unit, transform into that unit. After transforming, it may not move or attack again that turn.
Unchoosable. Cannot move more than 4 Diamond from its Phylactery. When it dies, its Phylactery loses 5 Health.

Cannot be directly damaged. At the start of each owner turn, if no linked Lich exists, spawn one adjacent to the Phylactery. Whenever that Lich dies, the Phylactery loses 5 Health; after four Lich deaths, the Royal is defeated.

As an active ability, possess an adjacent friendly non-Royal unit; that unit becomes the Royal. The Phantom may unpossess on its owner turn, but may not move or attack afterward. If the possessed unit dies, the Phantom dies.
The first time it would drop to 0 Health, it survives at 20 Health instead.
May move twice per owner turn.
Attacks ignore forests for line of sight and deal +10 damage to targets in forests.
Its attack pierces every unit along the same straight line within range.
Attacks made from behind the Chimera deal +15 damage to it.
After hitting the target, lightning chains through adjacent enemy units. Each additional chained unit takes 20 damage.

As an attack, build either three Gates (30 Health; friendly units may pass through, enemies may not) or one Snare. A unit ending movement on a Snare cannot move during its next owner turn, then the Snare is destroyed. May demolish any structure in range for free.

As an attack, pick up one directly adjacent 1×1 unit. It moves with the Cyclops and cannot move itself, but may attack the Cyclops if in range. The Cyclops may throw its carried unit to an empty square within 2–3 Diamond.

As an attack, Petrify one non-Royal unit in range. Each Medusa may Petrify only one unit at a time. A Petrified unit cannot move, attack or use active abilities, and cannot be attacked. Petrification ends if Medusa Petrifies another unit, moves more than 5 tiles away or dies.

Once per owner turn, choose up to three friendly units with non-zero Move and move each 1 tile to a legal square. Units moved this way cannot make a normal movement later that turn. After Atlas attacks an enemy, push it 2 tiles directly away. If the full push would be illegal, stop it at the furthest legal square before that.

Once every 5 owner turns, choose Chronos and one living friendly unit within 3 Circle. Return each to the position and Health they had at the start of your previous turn. This cannot revive units or restore money, objectives, structures or other game state.
As an attack, attach to one friendly unit. While attached, improve that unit's Move and Attack patterns by one step: Line or Diagonal → Diamond, Diamond → Circle, Circle → Square.
Ignores terrain (except roads) and may move through other units.
Its Move range is increased by 2 when the destination is forward.
After killing an enemy unit, gain half that unit's base cost, rounded to the nearest 5 gold.
While at 20 Health or less, its Attack becomes 40.
May be placed in No-Man's-Land.
As an attack, attach to a friendly non-Royal unit. While attached, the Shieldsman takes incoming damage for that unit. A unit may have only one Shieldsman attached.

As an attack, build one 5-Health Rune affecting friendly units in the surrounding 3×3 area: +10 Attack, +1 Move, 5 less damage taken, or +2 Attack Range. Bonuses from multiple Runes of the same type do not stack. May demolish any structure in range for free.

Consists of three 1×1 segments—front, middle and back—each with 40 Health. All segments follow the front when moving; only the front may attack. When a segment dies, reconnect the remaining segments and rename them so the leading segment is always the front.

Ignores terrain. Up to three friendly 1×1 units may board it by moving onto it. Riders move with the Longboat and cannot act except to disembark onto an empty adjacent tile; after disembarking, they cannot take another action that turn. If the Longboat dies, place its riders on legal nearby tiles in boarding order.
As an active ability costing 125 gold, transform into Fafnir Dragon.
Unchoosable. Ignores terrain. On transformation, destroy terrain and structures overlapping its 3×3 footprint and push overlapping units to the nearest legal empty tiles.
Ignores terrain and unit collisions. As an attack, choose a unit in range and force it to make up to a 3-Square movement to a legal destination you choose.
Once every 4 owner turns, choose one friendly non-Royal unit within 3 Squares. Until the start of your next owner turn, the first time that unit would die it survives at 1 Health instead.

Once per owner turn, create a 1×1 Thunderstorm within attack range or move one existing Thunderstorm to another tile in range. Enemy units entering or ending movement on a Thunderstorm take 15 damage. Thor may have at most three Thunderstorms active.
May be placed in No-Man's-Land.
After attacking, if possible, move 2 tiles directly away from the target.

As an attack, place one TNT on an adjacent empty tile. On a later owner turn, detonate it as an active ability: every unit in the surrounding 3×3 area takes 30 damage and terrain there is destroyed. A Demolitionist may have only one TNT active.
When it attacks an enemy unit, steal 20 gold from that unit's team, up to the amount they currently have.
Its attack marks the target; a Duelist may have only one marked unit. If the marked unit attacks while the Duelist is in its attack range, it must target the Duelist.
Reflects half of incoming damage back to the attacker, rounded down.
May move through enemy units, dealing 25 damage to each crossed unit.

When an ordinary Prison is destroyed, release all imprisoned units onto the closest legal squares, preferring down-right when equally close, then spawn two Cowboys and two Brawlers by the same rule. A Sheriff-linked Prison releases its prisoners but does not spawn Cowboys or Brawlers.
When hired, immediately pay 20 gold. At the start of each owner turn, pay another 20 gold or it becomes neutral. You may fire it on your turn, making it neutral.

Attacks by landing on an enemy. If the target dies, move onto its square; otherwise return to the previous square of the movement. A successful landing attack also pushes the target 1 tile directly away. If the push would be illegal, leave the target on its current square.
When placed, choose one enemy non-Royal unit as its target. The Bounty Hunter may attack only that target. When the target dies, choose a new non-Royal target at the start of your next owner turn.

When placing the Sheriff, separately place one empty 3×3 Sheriff Prison for free on a legal square in friendly territory. When the Sheriff would attack a non-Royal enemy with 30 Health or less, it may arrest that unit instead of dealing damage. The linked Prison holds at most three units; imprisoned units cannot act. If it is destroyed, release prisoners in arrest order onto the closest legal squares, preferring down-right when equally close. A replacement empty Sheriff Prison costs 120 gold and does not spawn Cowboys or Brawlers when destroyed.
Once every 3 owner turns, choose one enemy non-Royal unit in range and pay twice its base cost to transfer it to your team. The transferred unit cannot act until your next owner turn.
May attack only once every two owner turns.
When it attacks, it dies after dealing its attack to every other unit in range.
As an attack, mark one enemy in range. The next damage that unit takes is doubled, then the mark is removed.
May attack only in the direction it is facing. Attempting to attack in another direction turns the Tank to face that direction instead.

May build up to two structures per owner turn: Roads, which remove forest or make an otherwise empty tile cost 0 Move for the building team; or 40-Health Barricades, which cannot be moved or attacked over. May demolish any structure in range for free.
May be placed in No-Man's-Land. When hired, immediately pay 25 gold. At the start of each owner turn, pay another 25 gold or it becomes neutral. You may fire it on your turn, making it neutral.
Its only attack damages every unit and Structure in the 5×5 area centred on the target, including friendlies. After firing once, the Missile Silo cannot attack again.

As an attack, claim one No-Man's-Land tile adjacent to your territory. The tile counts as your territory for unit placement and movement only; it never counts for objectives, scoring or Plunder delivery.

May also attack by landing on an enemy without spending its normal attack action. If the target dies, move onto its square; otherwise return to the previous square. A landing attack pushes the target 2 tiles directly away. If the full push would be illegal, stop it at the furthest legal square before that.

May be placed in No-Man's-Land and cannot be interacted with by units, Structures or terrain. A friendly unit may deploy onto the Helicopter's tile, destroying it; this deployment ignores normal placement restrictions except Lakes, unit collisions and unit-specific requirements.

Once per owner turn, pay 25 gold and choose one friendly non-Royal unit within 2 Squares that has not been upgraded before. Permanently give it one upgrade: +10 Attack, +20 maximum Health (and heal 20), or +1 Move.

Once every 3 owner turns, choose one enemy unit or Structure within 5 Circle. Until the end of its owner's next turn, its special abilities are disabled and it cannot generate income; movement and normal attacks are unaffected.
Ignores terrain for movement.
May attack up to three times per owner turn, but may attack each unit at most once that turn.
May be placed in No-Man's-Land.

As an attack, build either two connected Portals on empty tiles, which teleport friendly units between them when entered, or two impassable Seals that disappear at the start of your next owner turn. May demolish any structure in range for free.

Ignores terrain and other units while moving, cannot be pushed or pulled, and after being attacked pushes the attacker 2 tiles directly away. If the full push would be illegal, stop it at the furthest legal square before that.

May be placed in No-Man's-Land or your territory. When hired, immediately pay 5 Royal Health. At the start of each owner turn, pay another 5 Royal Health or it becomes neutral. You may fire it on your turn, making it neutral.
As an attack, destroy one terrain tile or Structure in range.
When it attacks an enemy, it may attach to that unit. Its host cannot attack the attached Succubus; another unit must do so. The Succubus may detach at any time on its owner's turn.
Must be placed adjacent to your Royal.
Must be placed on top of one friendly unit, killing that unit. The sacrificed unit may be in No-Man's-Land or your placement area.

As an active ability, attach to one friendly unit in range. At the start of each owner turn, that unit loses 5 Health but gains +1 Move and +15 Attack while the Imp remains attached. A unit may have only one Imp attached.
When the Herald moves, it may bring up to three adjacent friendly 1×1 units with it, preserving their relative positions where legal.
Once every 2 owner turns, Satan may lose 10 Health to force the opposing team to choose one: lose 30 gold; their Royal takes 20 damage; or one non-Royal unit of their choice takes 40 damage.
Attack a unit by landing on them; if they die, move onto the square they were on, else go to the previous square of your movement.
Attack a unit by landing on them; if they die, move onto the square they were on, else go to the previous square of your movement.
Attack a unit by landing on them; if they die, move onto the square they were on, else go to the previous square of your movement.
Attack a unit by landing on them; if they die, move onto the square they were on, else go to the previous square of your movement.
Attack a unit by landing on them; if they die, move onto the square they were on, else go to the previous square of your movement.
Attack a unit by landing on them; if they die, move onto the square they were on, else go to the previous square of your movement. Must be checkmated to die.
Can heal a unit within 1 Sqaure of it for 20 health
Can pick up any friendly unit. Cannot go more than 10 squares from the Field Hospital. Must have one to purchase.
Can only be seen by the enemy if they have an adajcent unit
As their attack, Teacher can change any friendly units within range to another units for the difference in price between the two units (min 0) maintaining current health proportion.
Can upgrade units for a cost
Holds a stone that is 3 by 3 and pushes it infront of you. Can only move forward.
